# CUI // SP-CTI
#
# floci RUNTIME BASE IMAGES -- the images floci pulls at run time for its
# container-backed services (flx-airgap-02). Distinct from `images-floci.txt`,
# which pins the emulator's OWN image: having floci cached is necessary and NOT
# sufficient, because none of these ship inside it.
#
# Bundle them for the high side with:
#     python tools/airgap/image_vendor.py --save --topic floci-runtime --json
#
# EVERY DIGEST HERE WAS MEASURED, not read off a README: `docker events
# --filter type=image` recorded while a live floci 2.0.1 was driven through
# each container-backed service with boto3. Method, dates and the per-service
# attribution are in args/floci_runtime_images.yaml, which is the declaration
# of record -- `tests/cloud/test_floci_runtime_images.py` asserts the two agree,
# so ONE measured fact cannot come to be spelled two ways.
#
# VENDOR THE VARIANTS YOU DECLARE. Lambda needs one image PER RUNTIME and RDS
# one PER ENGINE, so this file is the full measured set and not a shopping list:
# a deployment running only a python Lambda over postgres needs four of these
# eleven. `python -m tools.cloud.runtime_images --check --services lambda,rds
# --variants python3.11,postgres` says which.

# lambda/python3.11 -- public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.11
public.ecr.aws/lambda/python@sha256:755093e1da2ba33f6bd2295c5a6a7ed8b94f1ef347b6ca649874d9cbef5a3e3c
